The foundation, popularly known as Tinubu Must Stay (TMS), also urged those on the ballot with President Bola Tinubu to stop unnecessary opposition and convince Nigerians that they have better policies than those of the present administration to improve the country.
Speaking at a press conference in Abuja on Tuesday, the Director-General of the Movement, Marcel Ngogbehei, said they are not defending Tinubu as a person but rather looking at the initiatives he has taken.
Ngogbehei, a former Coordinator of the Obidient Movement, which supported the presidential ambition of Peter Obi in 2023, said the opposition and Nigerians generally must assess Tinubu based on the circumstances under which he came to power to determine whether his moves were right or wrong.
